[Benzinga news, 2026-10-30T13:31:57Z, by staff] Viatris Begins $36.50 Per Share Cash Tender Offer for Pacira BioSciences
Viatris Inc. has officially commenced a cash tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Pacira BioSciences for $36.50 per share.
Viatris Inc. has initiated a cash tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Pacira BioSciences at a price of $36.50 per share. The offer is scheduled to expire on November 16, 2026, unless extended. Completion of the acquisition is subject to customary conditions, including the tender of at least 50% of Pacira's outstanding shares and the expiration or termination of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) Antitrust Improvements Act. The company plans to utilize a section 251(h) short-form merger process to finalize the acquisition following a successful tender, which avoids the need for a shareholder vote.
